cultivation.penglai.chain.market.title: Mirage Market
cultivation.penglai.chain.market.blurb: A sea market guarded by an old clam: pay or cut your way in, trade for charts and peaches.
cultivation.penglai.chain.market.gate.de: Where sea meets sky, clam-breath rises into a floating market. An old mirage clam at the gate asks for a toll.
cultivation.penglai.chain.market.gate.to: The clam takes the essence and the gate swings open.
cultivation.penglai.chain.market.gate.pi: A thread of sword light splits the haze; shards of shell hold a few relics.
Your intent wavers, the haze closes, and you keep only a few grains of red clam-sand.
cultivation.penglai.chain.market.stall.d: The stall keeper unrolls a star-sea chart beside a basket of Penglai peaches: you may take one.
cultivation.penglai.chain.market.stall.c: The stars on the chart drift and settle into your Cosmos Charts.
cultivation.penglai.chain.market.stall.p: The peach melts on your tongue; clear qi runs through every bone.
cultivation.penglai.chain.market.tide.de: The tide roars; the market's towers turn translucent, about to dissolve.
cultivation.penglai.chain.market.tide.li: Among the fading stalls you find flux crystals and relics.
The tide surges and carries you home empty-handed.
cultivation.penglai.chain.market.tide.de: As you leave, the old clam breathes out a wisp of essence for you.
cultivation.penglai.chain.isle.title: Visit to Penglai
cultivation.penglai.chain.isle.blurb: An isle of peach groves: a hermit invites you to cross swords or share tea.
cultivation.penglai.chain.isle.shore.des: The mist parts on Penglai: blazing peach groves line the shore, patrolled by cranes.
cultivation.penglai.chain.isle.shore.pic: While the cranes turn away, you pluck a ripe peach.
A crane cries out; you walk on empty-handed.
cultivation.penglai.chain.isle.shore.bow: The master nods and grants you a line of Dao scripture.
cultivation.penglai.chain.isle.hermit.de: A white-haired hermit strokes his sword and invites you to test formations, or to share sea-mist tea.
cultivation.penglai.chain.isle.hermit.du: A hundred exchanges ring out; the hermit applauds your sword heart.
Your formation breaks at a single touch, yet you learn from it.
cultivation.penglai.chain.isle.hermit.te: Over the tea smoke the hermit lays out an unfinished star-go game for you.
The hermit walks you to the shore and offers a mirage shell or a bundle of talisman paper.
Held to your ear, the shell hums with the next mirage already gathering.
The paper smells of sea salt; the cinnabar glows red.
cultivation.penglai.chain.palace.title: Dragon Palace Banquet
cultivation.penglai.chain.palace.blurb: A banquet under the sea: bring Thunder Essence, win herbs, cinnabar and a thunder-sealed vault.
A water gate opens in the sea; a patrolling yaksha offers an invitation to the Dragon Palace banquet.
Seeing thunder light at the door, the palace folk part to welcome you.
The yaksha looks you over, then lets you in.
Finding no gift, the yaksha hands you a flask of sea dew and sees you off.
cultivation.penglai.chain.palace.feast.d: The Dragon King's table overflows with rarities; you may ask for one to take home.
cultivation.penglai.chain.palace.feast.h: The king sends lotus seeds and violet ganoderma for your herb garden.
cultivation.penglai.chain.palace.feast.i: Cinnabar mixed with ambergris and mermaid-silk paper: perfect for talismans.
cultivation.penglai.chain.palace.vault.d: Deep in the feast, the king lets you try the vault, but a thunder seal bars its door.
cultivation.penglai.chain.palace.vault.t: Break the seal with your thunder body
Your tempered body meets the seal and it bursts; flux crystals and thunder essence spill out.
The seal throws you back, but you glimpse the truth of thunder law.
cultivation.penglai.chain.palace.vault.d: Pleased by your restraint, the king gifts you immortal essence.
cultivation.penglai.chain.dragon.title: The Mirage Dragon's Pearl
cultivation.penglai.chain.dragon.blurb: A dragon's pearl becomes a maze: read it with geomancy, break it with swords or talismans.
cultivation.penglai.chain.dragon.pearl.d: A mirage dragon breathes out a pearl; in its light, towers flicker between real and unreal.
cultivation.penglai.chain.dragon.pearl.r: Your compass turns and the true towers appear; you sketch a page of charts.
The compass spins wildly; you enter the maze by instinct.
cultivation.penglai.chain.dragon.pearl.g: You snatch the pearl and relics tumble out of it.
The dragon breathes fog; pearl and towers vanish together.
cultivation.penglai.chain.dragon.maze.de: The light becomes a winding maze; sword qi crisscrosses its halls, echoing ancient blades.
cultivation.penglai.chain.dragon.maze.fo: Your formation turns and the maze crumbles; an old blade's intent sinks into your heart.
The corridors split your formation; you wander long before escaping.
cultivation.penglai.chain.dragon.maze.ta: Burn talismans to clear the way
Two talismans become fire dragons and burn a straight path, scattering relics.
cultivation.penglai.chain.dragon.dawn.de: Dawn breaks; the dragon sinks, leaving a wisp of breath and a peach beside the pearl.
cultivation.penglai.chain.dragon.dawn.br: The breath becomes immortal essence, its echo settling into your Dao.
cultivation.penglai.chain.dragon.dawn.pe: The peach is still warm from the dragon, sweet to the bone.

cultivation.hearttrib.stage.greed.label: Trial of Greed
cultivation.hearttrib.stage.greed.desc: Mountains of gold, elixirs and treasures fill the illusion, begging you to reach out. Your natal spirit's clear call brings you back best.
cultivation.hearttrib.stage.wrath.label: Trial of Wrath
cultivation.hearttrib.stage.wrath.desc: Old enemies surround you and old grudges boil over; only heavenly thunder can wash the anger away.
cultivation.hearttrib.stage.delusion.des: Old dreams of loved ones will not fade and you cling to them; starlight breaks the veil.
cultivation.hearttrib.stage.pride.label: Trial of Pride
cultivation.hearttrib.stage.pride.desc: In the illusion you crown yourself Immortal Emperor before kneeling crowds; your natal spirit shows you who you are.
cultivation.hearttrib.stage.doubt.label: Trial of Doubt
cultivation.hearttrib.stage.doubt.desc: Every vision says your path is wrong; read the lodges and prove the Heavenly Dao to yourself.
cultivation.hearttrib.stage.tianmo.label: Trial of the Heavenly Demon
cultivation.hearttrib.stage.tianmo.desc: A demon from beyond the heavens takes your own face to seize your Dao heart; only the hardest thunder can break it.
